apps.localizedDescription:
Manic EMU is your all-in-one retro gaming emulator. Step into the world of Manic EMU—where dreams and adventures begin!

[Supported Platforms]
Nintendo
▸ Nintendo 3DS(3DS)
▸ Nintendo 64(N64)
▸ Nintendo DS(NDS)
▸ Game Boy Advance(GBA)
▸ Game Boy Color(GBC)
▸ Game Boy(GB)
▸ Nintendo Entertainment System(NES)
▸ Super Nintendo Entertainment System(SNES)
▸ Virtual Boy(VB)
▸ PokeMini(PM)

SONY
▸ PlayStation(PS1)
▸ PlayStation Portable(PSP)

SEGA
▸ Sega Dreamcast(DC)
▸ Sega Saturn(SS)
▸ Sega Master System(MS)
▸ Sega Game Gear(GG)
▸ Sega SG-1000(SG)
▸ Sega Genesis 32X/Super 32X(32X)
▸ Sega CD/Mega-CD(MCD)
▸ Sega Genesis/MegaDrive(MD)

Atari
▸ Atari 2600
▸ Atari 5200 SuperSystem
▸ Atari 7800 ProSystem
▸ Atari Jaguar
▸ Atari Lynx

Arcade
▸ MAME
▸ DOOM

Mircosoft
▸ MS-DOS

SUN
▸ JAVA(J2ME)

More platforms coming soon!

[Key Features]
▸ RetroAchievements: Unlock challenges, shine with your glory trophies
▸ Unlimited Saves: Manual & 50 auto-save slots
▸ 5x Speed: Control the game’s pace
▸ Cheat Codes: Unlimited library for perfect playthroughs
▸ Retro Filters: Immersive visual effects
▸ Custom Skins: Authentic feel, third-party compatible
▸ Screenshot Tool: Share your epic moments
▸ Landscape Mode: Enhanced gameplay experience
▸ Custom Shortcuts: Redefine your controls

[iCloud Sync • Your Gaming Universe]
▸ Cross-device sync for games, saves, and settings
▸ Encrypted storage • Cloud backups • No progress loss
▸ Switch between phone and tablet seamlessly
▸ Play anywhere—your journey never pauses!

[Cloud Integration • One-Click Import]
▸ Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Baidu Cloud, Aliyun
▸ WebDAV/SMB protocol support—access the entire web!

[Controller Freedom • Play Your Way]
▸ Native Joy-Con/DUALSHOCK/Xbox support
▸ Bluetooth controllers/keyboards • Mac compatible
▸ Multi-controller connectivity
▸ Switch between solo play and multiplayer battles

[Cross-Screen Play • Conquer the Big Screen]
▸ AirPlay mirroring for lag-free streaming
▸ Phone-to-TV switching for parties or couch gaming
▸ Big screen + controller = Ultimate immersion

[Subscription Plans]
Unlock premium features via iTunes auto-renewal. Choose Monthly, Yearly, or Lifetime plans. Payment is charged to your iTunes account. Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal. No refunds for active periods.
To cancel: Go to Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions and manage your plan.

▸ Privacy Policy: https://manicemu.site/privacy-policy/
▸ Terms of Use: https://manicemu.site/terms-of-use/
▸ Official Site: https://manicemu.site
Email: support@manicemu.site

[Legal Notice]
This app is not affiliated with any game manufacturers. Platform names are used solely to describe supported environments. For inquiries, contact us—we’re here to help!

versions.localizedDescription:
JIT (iOS 26 & Earlier)

- Implemented broad JIT support compatible with iOS 26 and earlier versions
- Integrated support for StikDebug’s universal.js launcher (Special thanks to @Stossy11)
- Added JIT support for:
    - 3DS (Citra)
    - Dreamcast (Flycast)
    - Nintendo DS (melonDS)
    - Nintendo 64 (GLideN64 RDP / mupen64plus.next  Special thanks to  @Fareblyat)
    - DOS (dosbox-pure)
    - PlayStation 1 (beetle-psx)
    - Added setting to enable/re-enable JIT directly from the app
    - Improved JIT handling flow for iOS 26 (automatic redirect to reinitialize when required)

Core & Emulator Updates

- Updated 3DS (Azahar) to latest upstream
- Updated PSP (PPSSPP) to latest upstream
- Added SNES core (snes9x; sideloaded availability)
- Added PS1 core (PCSX-ReARMed)

3DS Improvements

- Fixed Vulkan-related crashes (Azahar)
- Fixed Home Menu compilation and freezing issues
- Added Artic Base Home Menu support
- Added support for transferring data from real hardware via Artic Base
- Added Pretendo network configuration support
- Improved Home Menu integration (direct install logic)
- Added fast-forward support (Citra)
- Added full-screen AirPlay mirroring (Citra)

PSP

- Added support for installing homebrew via ZIP import

DOS

- Added thumbstick to default DOS skin
- Fixed legacy JIT crash issues

J2ME

- Performance optimizations (J2meJS)

Controls & Input

- Fixed numeric keypad mapping issues
- Added support for direct native keyboard event mapping
- Improved controller mapping compatibility
- TriggerPro now supports native keyboard event mapping

UI & Customization

- Added new app icons
- Added default emulator core selection setting
- Added “Hide Platform” feature
- Added manufacturer-based sorting
- Fixed general UI issues
- Improved theme customization options

Library / Platform Organization

- Game Boy can now be categorized as Chromatic (CHM)
- DOS can now be categorized under Windows 95 / Windows 98

General Fixes & Stability

- Fixed multiple UI and transition issues
- Improved overall system stability across cores and features

This is a major release focused on a redesigned interface, expanded platform support, and advanced features. Landscape browsing, library management, and external controller navigation have been rebuilt. It also adds several new systems and brings Netplay to eligible Libretro cores.

Before You Update
- Dreamcast (Flycast): Existing save states will no longer work as of 2.0.0. Convert important save states to in-game saves before updating, or back up the `Flycast/dc` folder yourself.
- Wii: A BootMii-format `keys.bin` is required.
- Symbian: Install firmware in Settings first (`.ROM`; S60v2 and later also need `.RPKG`).
- GameCube / Wii: The core is still being optimized, so heat and frame drops should still be expected.
- MAME: A number of lesser-used arcade systems have been trimmed. Some obscure titles may no longer run.

Interface
Landscape
- A new landscape library, with most landscape pages redesigned.
- Built-in dynamic backgrounds. You can use or upload ShaderToy (GLSL) scripts to customize them. Only single-Image scripts are supported; complex scripts may increase battery use or heat.
- Multiple customizable card carousel styles.
- Focused background: when a game is selected, its banner can be used as the landscape focus backdrop.
- background music feature in landscape mode—besides built-in tracks, you can upload your own music files to use as background music.
- built in 12 sets of navigation and focus sound effects.

Game Options and Shortcuts
- A unified options list and interaction model throughout the app.
- Available actions are automatically arranged and regrouped for the current context.
- Advanced reordering: customize the order and grouping of options.
- A redesigned in-game shortcut menu. Shortcuts can appear on supported skins and in the in-game menu.

Navigation and Input
- A global focus and navigation system for iPhone and iPad. You can browse and interact entirely with a controller or keyboard.
- Hold Command or the controller’s Select button to view the shortcut cheatsheet.
- A unified navigation bar for more consistent browsing and editing.
- Many long-press and hidden actions have been replaced with more conventional, iOS-style interactions.
- Batch management and actions.
- Adaptive rotation throughout the app.
- Controllers can be assigned to a player slot. On cores that expect a keyboard, controller inputs can be mapped to keyboard events.

Features
Library and Artwork
- Covers now support separate icon and banner artwork. Box art is used in regular lists, icons in square layouts, and banners as the landscape focus backdrop.
- Online artwork from Libretro Thumbnails and SteamGridDB (Grids / Heroes / Logos / Icons; SteamGridDB requires your own API key).
- Switching platform or category rematches cover art.

Game Data
- Game metadata: auto-match, search the database, or edit it yourself (developer, publisher, series, genre, release date, region, overview, and more).
- ESRB ratings and matching icons. Rating icons can be hidden in Settings.
- A redesigned save-state manager with import and export.
- Scoped settings: the same option can be stored at game, platform, or global level, and each can be cleared or reset independently.
- batch scraping for covers, icons, and banners.

Shaders and Skins
- Real-time shader preview, without loading the shader first.
- Redesigned default GBA skin.
- Flex skins now support customizing button size and position.

Achievements, Cheats, and Netplay
- RetroAchievements pages are easier to read and load faster.
- MultiSet support: earn subset achievements without a patched ROM. Switching the achievement list only changes what is shown; it does not affect which sets you can unlock while playing.
- Online cheat database: search, multi-select add, and bookmarks.
- Netplay for many Libretro cores: host or join a room, public lobby, LAN scan, relay, spectator mode, and room password. Your Adventurer Card nickname is used as the Netplay display name. You can now trade trea

- Added WonderSwan support
- Added NAOMI, Atomiswave, and System SP arcade support
- Added Flash support
  · Skin button binding
  · Hardware keyboard input
  · Software keyboard input
  · Touch input
- Built-in, self-contained JIT — no external debugger required
- Added Slow Motion
- Improved GameCube and Wii performance
- GameCube now supports multi-disc games
- Improved Wii motion controls
- Simulate the Wii IR pointer by touch
- Add games from other emulators via a link
- Fixed some arcade systems that wouldn’t run
- Fixed Dreamcast games running too fast
- Fixed PSP crashes
- Added NDS lid open/close
- Improved rotation: with orientation lock on in Control Center, the app no longer snaps back to portrait
- In-game shortcut tips can now be turned off
- Landscape library can disable carousel style
- Smoother landscape carousel scrolling
- MultiDisc Helper supports more formats
- Hardware keyboard input for Symbian, Amiga, and C64
- Added RomM support
  · LAN self-hosted servers only
  · Sync only for games imported from RomM
  · Manual sync only, from the service card’s long-press menu
  · Pull ROMs, covers, metadata, manuals, and game saves
- Fixed a launch timeout that could quit the app on older devices
- N64 now supports ROMs larger than 64 MB
